run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 swept across all nine jurisdictions via web search (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, ACT). buy.nsw and AusTender surfaced the most concrete open ATMs. Tier 2 sampled: local councils (SSROC, several NSW councils), universities via TenderLink, water corporations and GBEs (Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water, Water Corporation WA, Transgrid, Snowy Hydro, NBN Co, Australia Post). Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing checked (SAP Business Network / Ariba Discovery, Rio Tinto Buy Local, BHP, Fortescue) — all registration- or login-gated with no publicly-advertised RFx visible this run, so only portals were recorded and no corporate tenders were fabricated. Two genuinely-new, currently-open opportunities were captured (SSROC T2026-02 and NSW Police Force YR-2026-0162_B); several other strong open opportunities matched dedup keys from prior runs and were not re-listed. Detail is snippet-level only: the egress proxy blocked every WebFetch call (see gaps), so no tender detail pages or specification documents could be opened.
gaps: WebFetch was egress-blocked for every domain tested this run (www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED). All opportunity detail is therefore WebSearch-snippet-derived; every captured tender still needs an authenticated/unblocked pass to read the notice detail page, specification documents, evaluation criteria and full closing timezone.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Business Network Discovery (Ariba Discovery), BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas and the major banks were checked; their live RFx are registration- or login-gated and no publicly-advertised corporate tender surfaced. Portals recorded in discovered_sources only; no corporate opportunities invented. Management-consultancy and panel RFPs remain invitation-only and out of scope.

Several strong currently-open opportunities were already captured in prior daily runs and matched existing dedup keys, so they were not re-listed to preserve first_seen semantics: buy.nsw Fire System Maintenance - Northern & Coffs Harbour Tunnels (close 9-Oct-2026), AusTender Health/PH25/16174 Health Technology Assessment & Support Services Panel (close 9-Oct-2026), buy.nsw SNSW/9635 Small Business Advisory Services, AusTender RFT 02-2026 AFP travel & occupational medical services (close 8-Oct-2026), University of Sydney PROC-2026-293 chiller/cooling tower replacement.

Closed/expired listings encountered in search results and deliberately excluded (not open): buy.nsw B12102 Tugun Tunnel Fire Panels 25.0000129384.1187 (closed 15-Dec-2025), buy.nsw C13 2025 Max Webber Library chiller/HVAC upgrade — Blacktown City Council (closed 18-Nov-2025), buy.nsw CAN-RFT-2011056 Fire Detection/EWIS Replacement PMBH/CH NCCI & BRDH — NSW Public Works (display period ended 20-Aug-2026).

Deep link (prcOpportunity URL) for NSW Police Force RFP YR-2026-0162_B and the explicit closing timezone were not captured from search snippets; closing time recorded as 3:00 PM with AEDT assumed (NSW is on AEDT from 5-Oct-2026).
Tier 2 and Tier 3 were sampled, not exhaustively crawled: most councils, TAFEs, universities, health districts and GBEs were deferred to future runs so coverage compounds over days.
